findings.summary: OGE ethics agreement (April 14, 2025) reveals 55 entity resignations, 150+ stock divestitures, Millennium USA LP hedge fund equity, and Brookfield Asset Management stock — the company that bailed out 666 Fifth Avenue
findings.detail: Ethics agreement to State Dept Acting Legal Adviser Richard C. Visek dated April 14 2025. Section 2 Resignations: 55 entities in Appendix A including Westminster Management LLC (Chairman and Managing Member), Kushner Investment Manager LLC, Kushner Credit Opportunity Fund LLC, K Multi Family Partners LLC, 65 Bay LLC, K 30 Journal Square entities, Riverchase Birmingham entities, Indiantown entities, plus 30+ property-specific corps and LLCs. Section 3 Divestitures: approximately 150 public company stocks plus SPDR SP Biotech ETF, Millennium USA LP (Izzy Englander hedge fund), Brookfield Asset Management Ltd, and Defiance Group Holdings LLC. CRITICAL: Brookfield Asset Management is the company whose subsidiary executed the 99-year lease bailout of 666 Fifth Avenue in 2018. Charles Kushner held equity in the entity that rescued the family flagship property. Also held 8 French companies while nominated as Ambassador to France: Air Liquide, Dassault Systemes, EssilorLuxottica, LOreal, LVMH Moet Hennessy, Safran, Sanofi, Schneider Electric. Spouse continues advisory services to Westminster Management LLC and Westminster Pillar Management LLC receiving guaranteed payments and management fees.

findings.summary: Charles Kushner held Brookfield Asset Management equity while Brookfield subsidiary executed 99-year lease bailout of Kushner flagship 666 Fifth Avenue — required to divest as Ambassador
findings.detail: OGE ethics agreement Appendix B lists Brookfield Asset Management Ltd as a required divestiture. Brookfield Real Estate executed the 99-year lease of 666 Fifth Avenue in August 2018, effectively bailing out the Kushner family from the disastrous 2007 purchase at 1.29B. Qatar Investment Authority holds a major stake in Brookfield. Charles Kushner holding Brookfield equity means he had a direct financial interest in the company whose subsidiary rescued the family flagship property. The QIA-Brookfield-666 Fifth triangle is a documented conflict: QIA invested in Brookfield, which bailed out 666 Fifth, while Jared Kushner as Senior Adviser influenced Middle East policy including the Qatar blockade. That Charles continued to hold Brookfield stock years later suggests ongoing financial alignment with the bailout entity.

evidence.evidence_ref: OGE ethics agreement April 14 2025 Appendix B; Brookfield 666 Fifth Avenue lease 2018; QIA-Brookfield investment relationship
